items.summary: Lhutel the Headless is a spirit ash in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Lhutel the Headless.

Spirit of a headless knight who leads the mausoleum soldiers. Wields a lance enrobed in Death and hurls spectral lances at foes.

Lhutel sacrificed her life so that in Death she could continue to protect a soulless demigod until their revival, earning her the hero's honor of Erdtree Burial.

details: Dropped by the Cemetery Shade in Tombsward Catacombs, Weeping Peninsula.

notes: Upgraded with Ghost Gloveworts.
Summons a spear-wielding Mausoleum Knight.
Deals Pierce damage and inflicts Death Blight build-up.
→ The Death Blight is mostly irrelevant outside of the Caelid Colosseum.
While she doesn't deal the most damage, she is quite capable of grabbing enemy attention with the Spectral Lance skill and very survivable thanks to a combination of a greatshield and a dodge.

Not the most aggressive, but her push-and-pull attitude towards attacking means that she pairs decently well with a more aggressive player build so that boss attention can be kept bouncing between targets.

infobox.item_effect: Summons spirit of Lhutel the Headless

items.name: Cleanrot Knight Finlay
items.japanese_name: 貴腐の騎士、フィンレイ (Kifu no Kishi, Finrei)
items.effect: Summons spirit of Cleanrot Knight Finlay
items.summary: Cleanrot Knight Finlay is a spirit ash in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of the Cleanrot Knight Finlay.

Finlay was one of the few survivors of the Battle of Aeonia, who in an unimaginable act of heroism carried the slumbering demigod Malenia all the way back to the Haligtree. She managed the feat alone, fending off all manner of foes along the way.

details: In a treasure chest at Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, guarded by a Cleanrot Knight. Located north of the Prayer Room grace on a rooftop that you need to jump down to from a rafter.

notes: Upgraded with Ghost Gloveworts.
Summons a scythe-wielding Cleanrot Knight.

Deals Slash and Holy damage and inflict Blood Loss build-up with her scythe, Pierce damage with her off-hand sword, Holy damage with her Miquella's Ring of Light, and Standard damage and Scarlet Rot build-up with her spit attack.
Can cast the Cleanrot Knights unique combination of Blessing's Boon (8 HP/s) and Flame, Protect Me (+60% Fire damage negation) to strengthen both herself and her summoner.
→ This counts as both as a Health Regen Buff and as a Body Buff, meaning it will not stack with other buffs of those categories and will override those already present.
Fairly durable, but most of her ability lies in her buff, her ability to harass foes from afar, and her ability to help slightly with Blood Loss build-up when attacking with her scythe.

infobox.item_effect: Summons spirit of Cleanrot Knight Finlay

items.name: Black Knife Tiche
items.japanese_name: 黒き刃、ティシー (Kuroki Yaiba, Tishī)
items.effect: Summons spirit of Black Knife Tiche
items.summary: Black Knife Tiche is a spirit ash in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of Black Knife Tiche.

Tiche was one of the assassins who, on the night of the plot, imbued her black knife with the Rune of Death and slew Godwyn the Golden. She was the daughter of the Black Knife Ringleader, Alecto, and was killed protecting her mother during their flight from the royal capital.

details: Dropped by Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader in the Ringleader's Evergaol.

notes: Upgraded with Ghost Gloveworts.
Summons a Black Knife Assassin.
Her dagger deals Slash, Pierce, and Holy damage, and her Blade of Death beam deals Holy damage.

Generally considered as one of the strongest Spirit Ashes due to strength of the percentage-based damage of her Blade of Death, and due to mostly being able to make up for her low health as she is able to dodge
→ It should be noted that her Blade of Death will not stack with that of a player using a Black Knife to cast their own Blade of Death.

infobox.item_effect: Summons spirit of Black Knife Tiche

items.name: Divine Bird Warrior Ornis
items.japanese_name: 神鳥の戦士、オルニス (Shinchō no Senshi, Orunisu)
items.effect: Summons spirit of Divine Bird Warrior Ornis
items.summary: Divine Bird Warrior Ornis is a spirit ash found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Ornis the divine bird warrior.

Spirit of the divine bird warrior from whom the horned warriors claimed descent. Clad in golden armor, and granted wings and feathers of divine invocation.

Ornis succeeded in taming the divine bird and made its wings his own as he soared through the sky. When he finally fell to earth, he lived on as the guardian deity of the temple quarter.

details: Found by Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace: Head north past the large Scarlet Buds and Kindreds of Rot. Go uphill and activate the Spiritspring and use it to jump on ruins above. There is an opening to the right side which lets you walk on the ledge. Continue on the ledge, jump across the gap and then make your way uphill. You can find this spirit summon inside the treasure chest in the building uphill.

infobox.item_effect: Summons spirit of Divine Bird Warrior Ornis

items.name: Taylew the Golem Smith
items.japanese_name: 鍛冶ゴーレム、テウル (Kaji Gōremu, Teuru)
items.effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith
items.summary: Taylew the Golem Smith is a spirit ash found in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Taylew the golem smith.

The spirit of the stalwart stone golem who launches his own fists as projectiles.

Taylew was said to be the runt of the litter and the first to stop moving, but it was he who became the guardian deity of smithery.

details: Obtained by reaching the end of the dungeon.

infobox.item_effect: Summons spirit of Taylew the Golem Smith

items.name: Ancient Dragon Florissax
items.japanese_name: 古竜フローサクス (Koryū Furōsakusu)
items.effect: Summons spirit of Ancient Dragon Florissax
items.summary: Ancient Dragon Florissax is a spirit ash in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
items.description:
Ashen remains in which spirits yet dwell. Use to summon the spirit of Ancient Dragon Florissax.

Florissax assumed this spirit form to offer her service to a new lord.

Uses her own dragonbolt to increase all damage negation (including physical) for herself and nearby allies. Strikes foes with the Flowerstone Gavel's dragonbolt to reduce enemy lightning damage negation.

Long ago, Florissax assumed human form to share Dragon Communion with the world. Now, she has acquired a human heart.

infobox.item_effect: Summons spirit of Ancient Dragon Florissax

items.name: Mimic Tear Ashes
items.japanese_name: 写し身の雫の遺灰 (Utsushimi no Shizuku no Ihai)
items.summary: Mimic Tear Ashes is a spirit ash in Elden Ring.
items.description:
Legendary ashen remains. Use to summon the spirit of a mimic tear. Summoning consumes HP rather than FP.

This spirit takes the form of the summoner to fight alongside them, but its mimicry does not extend to imitating the summoner's will. Mimic tears are the result of an attempt by the Eternal City to forge a lord.

details: In a treasure chest behind a Stonesword Key imp statue in Nokron, Eternal City.

notes: Upgraded with Ghost Gloveworts.
Summons an exact, AI-controlled copy of the player that uses their current equipment, including armor, talismans, spells, weapons, and consumable items.
→ However, the Mimic Tear deals less direct damage than a player would with the same equipment. However, healing and status build-up (and the damage from said status effect) remains the same.
→ Has a hard time selecting between several damaging spells, so it's best to only carry 1, maybe 2 such spells when using this Ash.
Takes much longer to becomes active compared to other Spirit Ashes, roughly 5 seconds instead of about 1 second.
A +10 Mimic Tear has 3.3 times the HP of the unupgraded (+0) version.
Rolls only rarely, meaning it is more inclined towards heavier, tankier setups.
The only Spirit Ash that is vulnerable to Death Blight.
Has infinite uses of all consumable Items.
→ Raw Meat Dumplings can serve as an infinite-use healing item, especially so since the Mimic is immune to Poison.
→ Hard to get or farm for items such as Sleep Pots are also very useful to slot.

items.name: Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet
items.japanese_name: 指巫女サロリナの傀儡 (Yubimiko Sarorina no Kairai)
items.effect: Summons spirit of Finger Maiden Therolina
items.summary: Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet is a spirit ashes in Elden Ring.
items.description:
One of Seluvis's puppets. Use to summon the spirit of the Finger Maiden Therolina.

Spirit of Finger Maiden who never met the Tarnished she was meant to guide. Uses healing incantations and Holy Water Pots, but she is not a fighter by nature and is ill-suited to battle.

A Maiden without a Tarnished. A Tarnished without a Maiden. And yet no guide to bring them together.

details: Can be acquired from Seluvis once you confront him about his secret puppet workshop at the Three Sisters.
Either her or the Jarwight Puppet can be gained from Seluvis for free. If she isn't selected she costs 2 Starlight Shards to buy.

notes: She is one of the npcs who appear at the Redmane Castle festival. She gives you the Polite Bow gesture. It is unclear if she has already been one of Seluvis's puppets at that point.
Unless one specifically wants Therolina it's generally better to select the Jarwight Puppet as the free gift since he costs 1 more Starlight Shard (3 total) to buy.
Upgraded with Ghost Gloveworts.
She can cast Great Heal to heal and throw Holy Water Pot to deal mild amounts of Holy damage (much more against Those Who Live in Death).

Not very strong. While she is the only Spirit Ash able to heal their summoner, not counting Cleanrot Knight Finlay and her regeneration buff, she is rather bad at keeping with her summoner to actually heal them and otherwise only deal minimal damage and almost useless for even distracting enemies.
→ Except for potentially killing Royal Revenants in two casts of Great Heal, Perfumer Tricia is generally a much better supportive summon.

infobox.item_effect: Summons spirit of Finger Maiden Therolina

items.name: Jarwight Puppet
items.japanese_name: 壺男の傀儡 (Tsubootoko no Kairai)
items.summary: Jarwight Puppet is a spirit ashes in Elden Ring.
items.description:
One of Seluvis' puppets. Use to summon the spirit of a jarwight.

Spirit of a man who wished to become the innards of a livingjar. A jar-hurling specialist who throws all manner of pots and jars.

The warrior jar once told the nameless man this: "You are not yet ready to join the warriors inside. No, you must apply yourself! Better yourself, and one day I will return for you."

details: Can be acquired from Seluvis once you confront him about his secret puppet workshop at the Three Sisters.
Either him or the Finger Maiden Therolina Puppet can be gained from Seluvis for free. If he isn't selected he costs 3 Starlight Shards to buy.

notes: Unless one specifically wants Therolina it's generally better to select the Jarwight Puppet as the free gift since he costs 1 more Starlight Shard (3 total) to buy.
Upgraded with Ghost Gloveworts.
Wears a Jar and uses a wide variety of pots.
→ Pots thrown includes Fetid Pots, Fire Pots, Freezing Pots, Lightning Pots, Oil Pots, Poison Pots, Redmane Fire Pots, Swarm Pots, and Volcano Pots.
Not very strong since the pots thrown are largely random, but nonetheless somewhat entertaining.

items.name: Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet
items.japanese_name: 眠りのドローレスの傀儡 (Nemuri no Dorōresu no Kairai)
items.effect: Summons spirit of Dolores the Sleeping Arrow
items.summary: Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet is a renowned ash in Elden Ring.
items.description:
One of Seluvis' favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Dolores the Sleeping Arrow.

Spirit of a handsome archer who dressed in the style of a man. Called the Silent Hunter by some, she fires St. Trina's arrows from her shortbow.

Dolores once belonged to the Roundtable Hold, where she was both a critic and a friend of Gideon the All-Knowing. It was because of her that he and Seluvis went their separate ways.

details: Can be obtained from Preceptor Seluvis after discovering his secret room and agreeing to take Seluvis's Potion to Nepheli Loux, Warrior. If a different puppet is selected, this one can be bought for 5 Starlight Shards from Seluvis. It can later be found on Pidia's body if the potion was given to someone else.

notes: Upgraded with Ghost Glovewort.
Summons a Tarnished wearing the Aristocrat Hat, Page Garb, and Page Trousers, and wielding a Red Branch Shortbow used to fire St. Trina's Arrow.
Deals Pierce damage and inflicts Sleep build-up.
→ Inflicts 96 Sleep build-up per arrow, enough to sleep most bosses within three to five arrows.
→ Smart enough to not attack a target that has been afflicted with long-term sleep.

Useful against enemies like the Godskin Nobles or Godskin Apostles since they have low resistance to Sleep and will be knocked out for up to a minute upon affliction. Conversely, she's completely useless against those immune to Sleep, such as the Black Knife Assassins, Night's Cavalry, and golems such as the Abductor Virgins.

infobox.item_effect: Summons spirit of Dolores the Sleeping Arrow

items.name: Nepheli Loux Puppet
items.japanese_name: ネフェリ・ルーの傀儡 (Neferi Rū no Kairai)
items.summary: Nepheli Loux Puppet is a spirit ash in Elden Ring.
items.description:
One of Seluvis's favorite puppets. Use to summon the spirit of Nepheli Loux.

Puppet of a warrior who was betrayed by her pure heart. Wields a Stormhawk Axe in both hands and uses the Thunderstorm skill.

A diamond in the rough, deserving of special care lest its potential be squandered. Nepheli Loux truly was a warrior.

details: Can be obtained through Preceptor Seluvis's questline, if Seluvis's Potion is given to Nepheli Loux.

notes: Upgraded with Ghost Gloveworts.
Summons Nepheli Loux, Warrior.
Deals Standard and Lightning damage.

While she's weaker than both the Dung Eater Puppet and the Mimic Tear Ashes, she's still quite durable and able to dash around to somewhat avoid hits, and the combination of her dual-wielding Axes and Thunderstorm skill both deals decent damage and will contribute towards breaking the Stance of enemies.

items.name: Dung Eater Puppet
items.japanese_name: 糞食いの傀儡 (Kusogui no Kairai)
items.effect: Summons spirit of the Dung Eater
items.summary: Dung Eater Puppet is a spirit ash in Elden Ring.
items.description:
One of Seluvis's puppets. Use to summon the spirit of the Dung Eater.

Spirit of a man who murdered thousands and defiled their corpses with the Seedbed Curse. Wields a spine greatsword and hurls curses.

The Dung Eater despaired at how he met his end. How hideous and sinister this puppet is, and yet, its utter despair invites one to care for it.

details: Free the Dung Eater from beneath Leyndell, Royal Capital, then defeat him at the pond where you found Blackguard Big Boggart and then return to the Dung Eater in his cell with Seluvis's Potion.

Costs 5 Starlight Shards and is only available after doing the steps above and buying Preceptor Seluvis's first two puppets, then reloading the area by teleporting or exiting to the main menu and re-entering. Exhaust Seluvis's dialogue to reset the area, and the dialogue option "I want a new puppet" should be available", which will unlock him.

notes: This puppet cannot be acquired in the same new game cycle as the Nepheli Loux Puppet.
Upgrade with Ghost Gloveworts.
Summons the Dung Eater.
Deals Standard damage and inflicts Blood Loss build-up with his sword, and Holy damage with his Omen Bairn projectiles.

This item is normally mutually exclusive with the Omen Set. However, it may be possible to acquire both his armor set and this puppet in the same new game cycle. This is done by first feeding him the potion when he is bound up in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, as usual, and then killing him after his dialogue finishes.
→ This means his puppet body won't show up in Seluvis's Cellar, but he should still be available for purchase.

Quite durable and capable of dealing decent damage thanks to the Blood Loss on his weapon, and his ability to lower enemy defences with Shriek of Milos makes him one of strongest Spirit Ashes in the game.

infobox.item_effect: Summons spirit of the Dung Eater

items.name: Nightmaiden & Swordtress Puppets
items.japanese_name: 夜巫女と剣士の傀儡 (Yorumiko to Kenshi no Kairai)
items.summary: Nightmaiden & Swordtress Puppet is a spirit ash in Elden Ring.
items.description:
An old puppet crafted in the Eternal City. Use to summon the spirits of a nightmaiden and a swordstress.

These sisters, members of a cold-blooded race who wield flowing weapons, became puppets of their own volition.

details: Found in a chest in Nokstella, Eternal City, in a room unlocked using a Stonesword Key.
From the Nokstella, Eternal City Site of Grace, simply head up the stairs until there is long bridge to your right, and the correct building will be on your left.

notes: Upgraded with Ghost Gloveworts.
Summons a Nox Swordstress and a Nox Nightmaiden.
Both deal Slash damage with their attacks, and the Night Maiden's Mist deals Standard and fixed damage.
Unlike the player's own Night Maiden's Mist, and like the Mimic Tear Ashes version of the spell, this spell will only damage enemies and not the Nightmaiden herself.

Quite capable against enemies that they can stunlock by simply attacking, the Swordstress has great reach and they are both fairly evasive, but they will quickly falter against sturdier foes such as most bosses. Likewise, they are not very durable and will quickly fall if counterattacks can keep them stunlocked.
